note: Story questions in words none of the engine's own templates use, each with its taxonomy case, its shape (§10, §13) and, for a one-step story, its answer (goals/j3-story-shape.yaml, goals/md4d2b1-times-story-shape.yaml). The + and − stories written 2026-09-28 by the engine's session; the × and ÷ stories 2026-10-12, three or more for each of the taxonomy's 27 story cases. Three corrected the same day, found where the reader on live disagreed and held to the case rows' own words (DECISIONS-LOG 2026-10-12): a number found by working back from two known steps is W28, not W29; tickets not sold are the other part of a whole, W08, as the football story beside it; two prices in a sentence are a number the question does not need, B25, and a price list sets its prices out as a list, B26 (the canteen's list stays B26, though the reader took it for B25) — a W29 and a B26 story added to keep three; `test_story_shape.py` and `test_story_shape_times.py` check every one-step answer against its case's own operation, worked apart from the engine (a remainder dropped, rounded up, asked for, or both), so a story filed under the wrong case fails before any model is asked. To be replaced by educators' own questions as they are typed in. `engine eval story_shape` scores Jev against it.

stories.text: Kabir's cricket team made 46 runs before lunch. After lunch they made 38 more. What was their total score?
Meera saved ₹125 in June. In July she saved another ₹60. How much has she saved now?
A tank held 250 litres of water. Then 140 litres more were poured in. How much water is in the tank now?
Dev had read 57 pages of his story book. Today he read 26 pages more. How many pages has he read in all?
Zoya had 28 bangles. Her aunt gave her a few more, and now Zoya has 45 bangles. How many bangles did her aunt give her?
The class library had 132 books. After the book drive it had 210 books. How many books were given in the drive?
Arjun had ₹75 in his piggy bank. On his birthday he got some money and now he has ₹200. How much money did he get?
There were 19 ducks in the pond. More ducks came, and then there were 34 ducks. How many ducks came?
Tara had some crayons. Her friend gave her 12 more, and now she has 40 crayons. How many crayons did Tara have before?
A farmer had some goats. He bought 25 more at the market. Now he has 73 goats. How many goats did he have earlier?
Some people were sitting in the auditorium. 118 more people walked in, making 300 people. How many were sitting there to begin with?
Ishaan had a stack of coins. His dad added 9 coins to it and the stack now has 31 coins. How many coins were in the stack first?
A baker made 96 cupcakes and sold 58 of them. How many cupcakes does the baker still have?
Riya had a ribbon 150 cm long. She cut off 65 cm for a gift. How long is the ribbon that remains?
Neel picked 42 guavas. On the way home he gave 17 to his neighbours. How many guavas did he bring home?
Anaya had 64 balloons for the party. Some burst, and she has 49 left. How many balloons burst?
The shopkeeper had 240 notebooks in the morning. By evening only 95 were left. How many notebooks did he sell?
Vihaan took ₹500 to the fair and came back with ₹215. How much did he spend at the fair?
A jar had 53 toffees. The children ate some, and 18 are left in the jar. How many toffees did the children eat?
Sana gave away 16 of her storybooks and still has 29. How many storybooks did she have before giving any away?
A rickshaw driver spent ₹85 on lunch and had ₹340 left. How much money did he have before lunch?
Some pigeons were on the roof. 23 flew off, and 38 stayed. How many pigeons were on the roof at first?
After 150 kg of rice was sold, the shop still had 275 kg. How much rice did the shop have in the beginning?
In the orchard there are 57 mango trees and 36 chikoo trees. How many trees are in the orchard?
A school van carries 14 girls and 17 boys. How many children does the van carry?
The morning school has 128 children and the afternoon school has 135 children. How many children are in the two schools together?
A garland has 48 white flowers and 29 orange flowers. How many flowers are on the garland?
A box of 72 crayons has 45 wax crayons and the rest are pencil crayons. How many are pencil crayons?
There are 250 students on the playground. 138 are playing football. How many are not playing football?
There were 305 tickets for the school play. 187 were sold. How many tickets were not sold?
Of the 36 eggs in the tray, 19 are brown. How many eggs are white?
A cricket kit costs ₹900. The bat in it costs ₹560. What do the other things in the kit cost?
Priya is 132 cm tall and her brother is 118 cm tall. How much taller is Priya?
Team Blue won 45 matches. Team Green won 28 matches. How many fewer matches did Team Green win?
A red pen costs ₹35 and a gel pen costs ₹62. What is the difference in their prices?
Pune got 84 mm of rain this week and Mumbai got 210 mm. By how much did Mumbai's rain exceed Pune's?
Rohan has 26 marbles. Aditi has 15 marbles more than Rohan. How many marbles does Aditi have?
A cycle costs ₹2350. A scooter toy costs ₹480 more than the cycle. What does the scooter toy cost?
The banyan tree is 17 m tall. The coconut tree is 6 m taller than it. How tall is the coconut tree?
On Monday 208 people visited the museum. On Tuesday 95 more people visited than on Monday. How many visited on Tuesday?
Leela scored 87 in the quiz. Omar scored 12 less than Leela. What was Omar's score?
The blue bag weighs 5400 g. The green bag is 1250 g lighter. How much does the green bag weigh?
Class 2A planted 63 saplings. Class 2B planted 18 fewer saplings than 2A. How many saplings did 2B plant?
A train ticket costs ₹340. A bus ticket costs ₹125 less than the train ticket. What is the bus fare?
Aarav walked 350 steps to the park, 275 steps around it, and 360 steps back home. How many steps did he walk?
A shop sold 48 kites on Friday, 65 on Saturday and 92 on Sunday. How many kites did it sell over the three days?
Nisha had 120 stamps. Her uncle sent her 35 stamps and her cousin gave her 42 more. How many stamps does she have now?
Mohan took ₹600 to the market. He spent ₹240 on vegetables and ₹175 on fruit. How much money did he bring back?
A bus left the depot with 52 passengers. 14 got off at the first stop and 19 got off at the second. How many are still on the bus?
A roll of cloth is 90 m long. The tailor cuts 25 m for curtains and 18 m for cushions. How much cloth is left?
The class had 38 pencils. 12 were lost during the week and the educator brought 20 new ones. How many pencils does the class have now?
Kiara had ₹450. She spent ₹180 on a gift, then her grandmother gave her ₹100. How much money does Kiara have now?
There were 85 birds at the lake. 27 flew away and later 16 new birds arrived. How many birds are at the lake?
A library had 420 books. It received 150 donated books and then sent 95 old books for repair. How many books are on its shelves?
Yash had 64 cards. He won 23 cards in a game and then gave 30 to his sister. How many cards does he have?
A parking lot had 136 cars. In the morning 58 more cars came in, and by noon 72 cars had left. How many cars are in the lot at noon?
Rahul had some money. His father gave him ₹50, then he spent ₹80 on a book. Now he has ₹120. How much money did Rahul start with?
A basket had some apples. Maya added 15 apples, then 22 apples were eaten. Now there are 40 apples. How many were in the basket at the beginning?
Some children were in the pool. 9 got out and then 14 jumped in. Now there are 30 children in the pool. How many were in the pool at first?
I am thinking of a number. If I take away 25 and then add 40, I get 100. What number am I thinking of?
Aisha is 8 years old. She has 34 red beads and 27 blue beads. How many beads does she have?
A bus with 3 doors had 56 passengers. At the market 19 passengers got off. How many passengers are still on the bus?
Our school has 12 classrooms. On sports day 245 parents and 180 grandparents came to watch. How many visitors came in all?
A number is more than 30 and less than 40. Its ones digit is 2 more than its tens digit. What is the number?
Two friends have 90 stickers between them. One friend has 20 more stickers than the other. How many stickers does the friend with fewer have?
The sum of two numbers is 150 and their difference is 30. What is the bigger number?
A baker puts 6 buns on each tray. She fills 8 trays. How many buns has she baked?
Each auto-rickshaw brings 3 children to school. 9 auto-rickshaws arrive. How many children do they bring?
Grandmother knits 4 sweaters every month. How many sweaters does she knit in 7 months?
Mother divides 36 grapes equally between 4 bowls. How many grapes go in each bowl?
A coach splits 42 players into 6 equal teams. How many players are on each team?
56 crayons are handed out equally to 8 tables. How many crayons does each table get?
A gardener plants 54 saplings, 6 in each row. How many rows does he plant?
Class 3B has 32 children. They sit in groups of 4. How many groups are there?
Papa ties 45 sticks into bundles of 5. How many bundles does he make?
A window has 4 rows of glass panes with 6 panes in each row. How many panes are there?
The school band marches in 7 lines of 5 children. How many children march?
An egg crate has 3 rows and 10 eggs in each row. How many eggs fit in the crate?
A wall of 48 tiles is laid in 6 equal rows. How many tiles are in each row?
40 cupcakes sit on a tray in 5 equal rows. How many cupcakes are in one row?
A cinema has 90 seats set out in 9 equal rows. How many seats does each row have?
A mango costs ₹15. How much do 6 mangoes cost?
Entry to the zoo is ₹40 for each child. What do 5 children pay together?
A notebook costs ₹25. Riya buys 4 notebooks. How much does she spend?
7 erasers cost ₹63 together. What is the price of one eraser?
Dev paid ₹120 for 4 kites, each costing the same. How much was one kite?
A packet of 8 samosas costs ₹96. How much is one samosa?
Ali has 12 cards. Zoya has 3 times as many cards as Ali. How many cards does Zoya have?
A puppy weighs 4 kg. Its mother weighs 5 times as much. What does the mother weigh?
The red rope is 7 metres long. The blue rope is 6 times as long. How long is the blue rope?
A whale is 24 metres long. That is 4 times as long as a boat. How long is the boat?
Rohan scored 45 runs, 5 times as many as Kiran. How many runs did Kiran score?
The tall building has 36 floors, which is 3 times as many as the short one. How many floors does the short building have?
A pencil costs ₹6 and a pen costs ₹30. How many times as much does the pen cost?
Tara is 8 years old and her grandfather is 64. How many times as old as Tara is he?
A jug holds 21 glasses of milk and a bottle holds 3 glasses. How many times as much does the jug hold?
Nikhil ran 16 laps. His sister ran twice as many laps. How many laps did she run?
Last year the school planted 45 trees. This year it planted double that number. How many trees did it plant this year?
Meena's ribbon is 18 cm long. Her friend's ribbon is twice as long. How long is her friend's ribbon?
A café offers 3 kinds of bread and 4 kinds of filling. How many different sandwiches can be made with one bread and one filling?
Sana has 5 tops and 3 skirts. How many different outfits of one top and one skirt can she wear?
An ice-cream stall has 6 flavours and 2 kinds of cone. How many ways can you choose one flavour in one cone?
A carpet is made of square patches, 8 patches along one side and 5 along the other. How many patches make the carpet?
A rectangle drawn on squared paper is 7 cm by 3 cm. How many centimetre squares fit inside it?
A courtyard is paved with square stones, 12 stones long and 5 stones wide. How many stones pave it?
A shopkeeper packs 50 eggs into trays of 6. How many trays can he fill completely?
Asha has ₹75. A pencil box costs ₹20. How many pencil boxes can she buy?
A ribbon 38 cm long is cut into pieces 5 cm long. How many whole pieces are cut?
35 children are going on a picnic. Each van carries 8 children. How many vans must the school book?
Ravi has 22 photos to put in an album. Each page holds 4 photos. How many pages will he use?
100 guests are coming to a wedding lunch. Each table seats 8. How many tables are needed?
Kavya puts 29 sweets in bags of 6. How many sweets are not in a bag?
A coach makes teams of 7 from 45 children. How many children are not in a team?
62 books are packed in boxes of 8. How many books stay out of the boxes?
Dadi has 40 diyas. She places them in rows of 6. How many full rows does she make, and how many diyas are left?
A farmer packs 75 mangoes into crates of 10. How many crates are full, and how many mangoes are left over?
A week has 7 days. The holidays last 47 days. How many whole weeks is that, and how many days more?
Priya buys 4 packs of 6 juice boxes and 3 single boxes. How many juice boxes does she have?
A library has 5 shelves of 20 books and 15 more books on the desk. How many books are there in all?
Each of 6 children brings 3 flowers, and the gardener brings 10. How many flowers are there?
Neha had ₹200. She bought 3 comics for ₹45 each. How much money does she have now?
A farmer had 100 eggs. He filled 7 cartons of 12. How many eggs were not packed?
There are 9 rows of 8 seats in the hall, and 15 seats are broken. How many seats can be used?
6 apples cost ₹48. How much do 10 apples cost?
4 boxes of the same size weigh 20 kg. What do 7 such boxes weigh?
A tap fills 4 buckets in 12 minutes. How many minutes does it take to fill 9 buckets?
Mother buys 3 kg of rice at ₹50 a kg and 2 kg of dal at ₹90 a kg. How much does she spend?
A theatre has 10 rows of 12 chairs and 4 rows of 15 sofas. How many seats are there?
Ravi buys 5 pencils at ₹4 each and 2 erasers at ₹6 each. What does he pay altogether?
Kiran picked 23 flowers and Leela picked 17. They made 5 equal bunches. How many flowers were in each bunch?
Class 3A collected 36 cans and Class 3B collected 28. They put them into 8 bags equally. How many cans are in each bag?
Dad has ₹150 and Mum has ₹90. They share it equally among their 4 children. How much does each child get?
A box holds 40 red and green beads. There are 4 times as many red beads as green ones. How many green beads are there?
Sunil and his sister have ₹60 between them. Sunil has 3 times as much as his sister. How much does his sister have?
A garden has 35 roses and lilies. There are 4 times as many roses as lilies. How many lilies are there?
Mum gives 3 biscuits to each child at the party. She gives away 24 biscuits. How many children are at the party?
Every plant needs 5 litres of water. The gardener uses 40 litres. How many plants does he water?
A school gives 2 notebooks to each student. It hands out 64 notebooks. How many students get notebooks?
A school bus has 9 rows with 4 seats in each row. It leaves at 8 o'clock. How many seats does it have?
Aman is 9 years old. He buys 3 packets of 6 stickers. How many stickers does he buy?
A shelf has 5 rows of 8 books. 2 children are reading nearby. How many books are on the shelf?
At the stationery shop a ruler costs ₹12 and a sharpener ₹8. What do 4 sharpeners cost?
Price list: apple ₹20, banana ₹5. How much do 6 apples cost?
Canteen prices: idli ₹10 a plate, dosa ₹30 a plate. What do 3 plates of dosa cost?
Fruit stall: orange ₹12 each, guava ₹8 each. How much do 5 guavas cost?
Sameer has 48 marbles. His brother has half as many. How many marbles does his brother have?
A train travelled 300 km on Monday and half as far on Tuesday. How far did it travel on Tuesday?
The big pot holds 16 cups of rice. The small pot holds half as much. How many cups does the small pot hold?
